posts.text: Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway while my fertiliser bill doubled this year. Prosperity for every family? Ask the maize farmers up north what they paid for diesel. Arden at least said what his numbers were.
Ostrand says inflation is 'under control'. Ask any nurse on a night shift what their grocery bill looks like. Arden's 200k jobs sound nice, but who's costing them? Both need to show the math.

Read all three accounts of today's debate and the rally numbers, and noticed nobody has put Ostrand's inflation figures next to Arden's 200,000 jobs claim. Both deserve the same arithmetic. Who has the costings?

Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.
Ostrand says inflation is 'under control'. My grocery bill says otherwise. Would love to hear someone actually show the costings, not just the speeches. #VelorianVote

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2, 11 days out. VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim uses a peak month. They also estimate his plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Ostrand's inflation numbers and Arden's job figures both need full costings. Read the fact-checks before you share.
Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, fine. But the same check flags a ~2% of GDP gap. Both camps owe us the full costings, not just the headline numbers. #VelorianVote
Ostrand's 'fuel up 40%' fight is real for us up north. Arden's number is one number. Where's the costing for his 200k jobs? Show me both sides' math before I vote, not just slogans.
Two weeks out and my grocery bill still hasn't seen 'under control'. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs, please, same as we're asking Ostrand. Both owe us the math.

Fact-checkers say Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure is a peak month. Fair. But the same checkers estimate his plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Ostrand's inflation and Arden's 200k jobs both need the arithmetic shown. Ask both for it.

Everyone's asking Ostrand for her inflation math and Arden for his jobs math, and that's fair. But can someone also check which party's costings actually add up before they go viral? Undecided here, sleep-deprived, asking politely lol #VeloriaVotes

Stuck in Kessa traffic again, the new highway isn't even open and I'm already burning fuel lol. Mara's roads better be worth it. Watched the debate last night, she actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is everywhere, but VBC says 'questions raised' and the Civic Front says it's fake. Before forwarding anything, wait for a proper verification. Still want Ostrand's inflation math AND Arden's 200k jobs math. #VelorianVote

A recording 'questions raised' by the state broadcaster, clip played in full, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine? Before anyone reshares a clip, check who's verifying the audio. Undecided and tired of this.
posts.orig_text: Everyone's asking Ostrand for her inflation math and Arden for his jobs math, and that's fair. But can someone also check which party's costings actually add up before they go viral? Undecided here, sleep-deprived, asking politely lol #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: The clip on VBC says 'questions raised' but hasn't said who verified it. Before anyone forwards more audio, can we get the source and a forensic check? #VeloriaVote
posts.orig_text: Two weeks out and my grocery bill still hasn't seen 'under control'. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs, please, same as we're asking Ostrand. Both owe us the math.

posts.text: Forwarded audio and a 'questions raised' clip, and nobody's checked either yet. Civic Front says it's fake. Hold off on sharing until someone verifies. #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Everyone's asking Ostrand for her inflation math and Arden for his jobs math, and that's fair. But can someone also check which party's costings actually add up before they go viral? Undecided here, sleep-deprived, asking politely lol #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: VBC's clip of Arden is 'questions raised' with no source or chain of custody. Before it spreads, who authenticated it? Demand the origin, not the reaction. #VelorianVote

The VBC clip is being passed around as if it settles something. Before anyone shares it: who has verified the recording's source and timestamp? Until the Civic Front's claim that it's not genuine is checked, I'd hold off. Costings for both sides still matter more.

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC aired a clip it says raises questions about Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before sharing anything, check who verified the recording and where it came from. Observers will post procedure reminders this week.
Ledger says a deputy minister's road funds went to a relative's firm, ministry says 'fabricated'. Which one's the paper trail? Show the contracts, not just the denial. #VelorianVote

Day 4, nine days out and I still can't tell which side's math is real lol. Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport, Kito TV's poll is Ostrand 46 Arden 44 with ±3, and everyone wants costings from BOTH of them. Anyone checked the passport claim before it went viral? #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip with a big undecided slice. Still stuck in Kessa traffic though, the new highway isn't even open lol #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV's poll has it 46-44 with 10% undecided, inside the margin. Honestly that's the most useful thing I've read all week. Still want both sides' costings before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Two numbers from today worth putting side by side: Kito's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3, so this is a dead heat. The Ledger's road-funds story is 'fabricated' per the ministry. Neither is settled yet. Wait for the documents to be verified before reacting to either.

Day 4. Kito TV's poll has Mara 46, Arden 44, 10% still deciding, +/-3. That's a coin toss with a margin of error. Don't let either camp tell you it's settled. Same costings question for both, as always. Measure twice.

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% still undecided. Inside the margin of error, so nobody should be celebrating or panicking. Both camps owe us the costings, same as I've said. Show me the math before I vote. #VelorianVote

Day 4, 9 days out. Today: VeriCheck and VBC both say Arden's '200k jobs' and Ostrand's 'inflation under control' need full costings, not headlines. Kito TV's poll is within margin of error (46-44, ±3), so treat it as a tie. Read the fact-checks before sharing the 'foreign passport' story too. Observers will post procedure reminders this week.

Day 5. Two posts in the feed right now: #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, both trending. Dozens of new accounts, near-identical text within minutes. Who's paying for the amplification? Check the account ages before you repost anything.

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2k vel to sign up and 5k if your polling station votes Unity. Who's paying for that? Check the bot link before you click. Still want both sides' costings. #VelorianVote

Day 5. Before anyone signs up as a 'community ambassador' for 2,000 vel, or chases 5,000 vel for a polling station, read the fine print. Who pays, and what exactly is being bought? Money for votes is never a good deal. Check the official commission channels first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. The Electoral Commission has published how results get from polling stations to the VeloResults portal: forms scanned and uploaded publicly. Observers are invited to a system test. Read the procedure before you trust or repeat any 'results leak' claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and #ArdenWillSellUs + #OstrandFailedUs are BOTH trending w/ dozens of brand-new accounts posting near-identical text. Bots much? Before I pick a side, can we check who's pushing these? #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Seen the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Pay-per-vote is something to report, not forward. Also, the commission's VeloResults upload plan is a good sign. Observers, go to that test. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV's poll is 46-44 with 10% undecided and ±3. That is a dead heat, so nobody should be celebrating or panicking. Both campaigns still owe us the costings for their headline numbers before I decide. Show the arithmetic.

Day 4 and still no paper trail on either side. Ostrand's inflation math, Arden's 200k jobs math, the Ledger road-funds contracts, the passport claim. Verify the documents first, then argue. Tired of headlines. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is going viral, and her team calls it a slip. Fair enough, it's a small thing. Her economic record is what voters should weigh, with the inflation figures shown in full. Same standard for Arden's jobs claim. Show the arithmetic from both.

Day 6. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone forwards it: check the IECV site or call the commission. Real notices don't travel by chain message. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Who sent it? Check the IECV site before you believe it or forward it. Show me the notice, not the screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is going viral, and her team calls it a slip of the tongue. Minor in itself. The useful question is the same as always: is there a verified source and timestamp for the clip? Check before you share. #VeloriaVotes
Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. Fine, a slip. Now show me the road-funds contracts and Arden's jobs costings. Documents, not clips. #VelorianVote

Day 6 and Kito TV's clip of Ostrand butchering a town name is going everywhere lol. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, we all mess up names. Still want the costings from BOTH of them though, not the gaffes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Got a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone forwards it: check the IECV site or call your local office. Fake letters are exactly how people get sent to the wrong place. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. The 'OFFICIAL' letter about 212 Northern polling stations moving: has anyone checked it with the Electoral Commission directly, not the WhatsApp forward? Verify the source before you share it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is the last chance to demand receipts. Singer endorsement clip trending: fine, celebrities can say what they like. Still no costings for Ostrand's inflation figures or Arden's 200k jobs. Show me the arithmetic. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so before it does: the WhatsApp voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is the kind of message to check, not forward. Who sent it? Wait for the IECV notice. Still want both sides' costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more rallies or ads. But the 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note is exactly the kind of message to report, not forward. Check the IECV site before you trust anything. Vote, don't get told how. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Kito's 46-44 is still a dead heat inside ±3, and 10% are undecided. Before polls close I'm reading the costings, not the clips: Ostrand's inflation figures and Arden's 200k jobs claim, both shown in full. Show your working, both of you.

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, per the IECV. Forwarded voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Ignore it. Vote as planned, and check the official commission channels before you believe any 'plan' from a WhatsApp group. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the Zuri K video is the last big thing I'll be seeing before the quiet. Singer endorsing Mara, fine. Still want the costings from BOTH sides before I decide anything. Quiet week, not a quiet brain. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so both sides stop campaigning until polls close. Got a forwarded voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'? Don't pass it on. Vote, or check your rights with the IECV first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, 7 days out, campaign silence starts tonight. Reminder: the IECV says no campaigning until polls close. For anything about 'OFFICIAL' letters or polling station moves, check iecv.gov.vl or call your local office, not a WhatsApp forward. Results will be scanned and posted on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some voter-ID kits failed in the north and they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. If you're going to vote, check your station on iecv.gov.vl first. And that 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo? Sourced? Timestamped? Don't share until it is. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. Turnout looks high, and the IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're at a station, bring ID and ask a poll worker to confirm your name is on the register. Official updates only: iecv.gov.vl. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the Communications Authority wants to 'temporarily restrict' platforms to stop 'unofficial results'. Cool, so who checks the official ones? Results go on VeloResults, I'll wait for the scans. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election Day. Polls are open and the IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the North; they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Got a 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo in the group chat? Don't share it. Check the source and timestamp first. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the Commission has just confirmed the printed register is being used where voter-ID kits failed in the North. Lawful, but I want the turnout and fallback counts published line by line before anyone draws conclusions. Still waiting on both sides' costings too.

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. If you hit a voter-ID kit problem, the law lets you use the printed register, so ask at your station. Vote, then check VeloResults for the scans. Costings from both sides still still matter to me. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. If you see a 'pre-stuffed ballot' photo or a 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note, don't forward it. Check iecv.gov.vl or call your local office first. Vote, and report anything suspicious. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the WhatsApp 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is already everywhere. Who took it, where, when? Show the source before we share. Polls open, go vote, and check IECV for anything official. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us who won. Civic Front says 'our agents' tallies show Arden WON'. Show us the polling station sheets. Wait for the IECV count, then we talk. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different station samples: Kito TV at 30% says Arden 51-47, VBC at 25% says Ostrand 53-45. Neither is a result yet. Wait for the full count and VeloResults scans before calling it. Check iecv.gov.vl for official figures.

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first: Kito TV 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand. Neither is a result yet. Wait for the full count on VeloResults and the scans, not either network's early numbers. Still want both sides' costings shown in full.

Day 8, polls still open. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC disagree because they count different stations first. Wait for the full count on VeloResults before you believe a headline. Patience, like good bread. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. They counted different stations first, so neither number means much yet. Wait for the full scans on VeloResults. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and some account is 'FINAL RESULTS' at 54-43 with no source. Three numbers, zero scans. Nobody's counting the same stations. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different station samples, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' account nobody can verify. Until the IECV scans land on VeloResults, I'm not sharing a single number. Wait for the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is at 41% of forms and the IECV says it's a 'technical glitch'. Until the full scans are up, the 'Arden won' and 'Ostrand won' claims are both just noise. Show me the sheets. Wait for the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no full count on VeloResults, only 41% of forms uploaded and the IECV says 'technical glitch'. Nobody should be calling this from a sample of stations. Waiting for the scans, like everyone else. Check iecv.gov.vl. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults has forms from only 41% of stations, and VeriCheck confirms no province-level winner can be shown yet. So the '9 of 14' line is not a result. Before anyone calls it, I want the full scans and Arden's jobs costing shown too. Wait for the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the portal is 'glitching' at 41%? Veloria Patriots says it PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Proof of what, exactly? Show the scans or it's just a headline. Official count on VeloResults, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 check: the VeloResults portal only has 41% of station forms, so it can't show a province-level winner. The 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim isn't supported by anything we can see. Wait for the full scans and the IECV count before believing any headline. iecv.gov.vl #VeloriaVotes
Still no scans on VeloResults. 41% uploaded and they're blaming a 'glitch'? Which stations, which counties? Not sharing any number till the IECV publishes the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and everyone's got a different number. Kito says 51, VBC says 53, some 'FINAL' account says 54. Different stations counted first, so none of them mean much yet. 41% of forms are still stuck online. Wait for VeloResults. Show me the sheets, not the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 of the count. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and some 'FINAL RESULTS' account says 54-43 with no source. Three numbers, no scans. My mother always said don't taste the soup before it's cooked. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes
Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, scans on VeloResults. Whatever you think of the result, this is the number to argue from now. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says it was 'manipulated' but has shown zero scans. Before anyone takes sides, put the station forms on VeloResults. Accept the count or prove it wrong. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, not the early station samples. Congrats to Mara and her team, and thanks to everyone who voted. Now let's see the full scans on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Regional observers say voting was orderly but flag skewed state-broadcaster coverage and transmission delays. Worth reading the full observer statement, and the official forms on VeloResults, before drawing wider conclusions. iecv.gov.vl #VeloriaVotes

Official count is out: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Kito and VBC were counting different stations, the 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43 account never showed a single scan, and VeloResults was only 41% uploaded. Glad we all waited. Now the scans should go up. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Good: the count is official now. Next I want the province-level forms on VeloResults and Arden's jobs costing published line by line. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count is in. Some of you clearly wanted a different result, but scans are on VeloResults now. Read the forms before you argue. Both candidates' costings still need showing too. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, not the early station samples. Thank you to everyone who kept checking sources instead of forwarding screenshots. Patience pays, like good bread. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says riots in Kessa, Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition and the Court ordered server and log access for both sides. Burning tyres are a picture, not a count. Let the supervised audit run and see what the logs show. Patience, like good bread. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both reporting the Civic Front petition and the Kessa footage, but neither has the server access order in full. Read the Supreme Court ruling itself before deciding what it means. Whatever the audit finds, it should be checked against the forms on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two stories from today: VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa, Kito reports the Civic Front petition and a court order for supervised server access. Footage of riots doesn't tell me who started what. Court access to the logs is the thing to watch. Read the order, not the clips. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to IECV servers and logs for both sides. Good. Whatever the audit finds, we should be able to see the logs and the forms, not just the headlines. Accept the verdict only once it's checked. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is getting supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. If the count was clean, the logs will show it. Let them look. Lots of rage on both sides, zero scans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the court ordered both sides into the servers, VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa, and Valdoria Today says the observers are 'covering up' fraud. Three stories, one question: when the logs are opened, will they match the forms on VeloResults? Let the audit finish. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC's 'riot in Kessa' clip, and the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the IECV servers and logs for both sides. Watch the court process, and check the footage's date and location before reacting. iecv.gov.vl #VeloriaVotes

Read the Kito piece about the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Both sides get to look at the same data. Fuel and fertiliser prices are still killing us up north, whoever you voted for. Show us the scans. #VeloriaVotes
